rationale: Price is at the absolute top of today's range (100th percentile) and pressing against today's high of $66.60, with the last print at $66.71 already marginally above it — suggesting a potential breakout attempt, but the spread is wide (25.5 bps), the stock gapped down on a Q3 earnings miss and has been a chronic underperformer, and the broad market is up 2.33% today which may be driving a mechanical short-squeeze rather than a sustainable directional move.
